tasks.short: Develop and coordinate a fire prevention program

steps.what: Assemble and compare existing fire inspection reporting records, unresolved prevention issues and current program requirements in the inspection case system {OTHER}.
Develop the fire prevention program's objectives, coverage, reporting responsibilities and exception process using the actual needs and available capacity.
inputs: Actual available capacity and policy constraints

steps.what: Coordinate the proposed program with the responsible inspection and management colleagues, resolving real ownership, timing and operational constraints.
outputs: Actual coordinated decisions and unresolved items

steps.what: Write the actual program document and coordination actions in {DOCS}, including the real decisions, responsibilities, milestones and unresolved issues.
Check the completed program document against the actual decisions, responsibility owners, authority limits and intended coordination recipients.
outputs: Checked exact program version and coordination recipients

steps.what: Save the checked fire prevention program document in the controlled program folder {DOCS}.
Send the exact checked program and coordination actions to the verified responsible colleagues through {EMAIL}.

tasks.design: For an inspection-reporting prevention program, configure saved views in the existing case system and structured program-document fields. Reuse real case identifiers and owner fields, while the inspector develops the program and coordinates it with people. No agent is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated case filtering and copying established program fields consumes active preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case-system views and controlled document templates can retain that setup.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing useful prevention objectives and agreeing real operational responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Balancing public safety priorities with capacity and resolving ownership conflicts.

ambition.what: Support development and coordination of the existing prevention program.

tasks.altitude: Program design and operational coordination stay human.

evidence.claim: Native case views and structured document fields can reduce repeated preparation without designing a prevention program or securing colleagues' agreement.

assumptions: The task's examples are alternative programs. This design covers an actual inspection-reporting program from needs assessment through coordination, not merely a report. It claims no additional saving for false-alarm billing, hazardous-material permitting or their transaction systems.
All shares are E1 planning assumptions, not measured baselines. Savings require real repeated manual filtering and field copying; already configured views and templates give zero.

s1 counts assembly and source inspection of existing actual records. Missing or inconsistent evidence is resolved manually. No complete new status feed or free meeting transcript is assumed; s3 elicits actual decisions and s4 records them.
s5 is the ordinary final package check, not an added self-approval stage. It gates the exact save and send, with 1% fully retained for each. Any changed decision or recipient requires recheck.

The coordination package is within existing program authority. It does not automatically change inspection rules, issue bills, grant permits or bind colleagues to unagreed work. Those operations and other colleagues' labour have no claimed saving.
research_questions: Can the native view reproduce a real reporting-program needs review without hiding unresolved cases?
Which document fields are actually recopied rather than newly reasoned?

already_counted.description: Source checking, full program design and coordination, residual writing, final checks and both actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain case filters and program-document mappings as reporting requirements change.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed program document checked in s5
Exact program document, actions and recipients checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 30% source-preparation reduction plus 20 x 25% repeated-field writing reduction = 11 gross points, less 1.5 upkeep. No saving on program judgment, coordination or action tails.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The inspector retains prevention-program design and coordination responsibility.
role.ambitious_version: A prevention coordinator who spends less time rebuilding views and documents while retaining judgment and real coordination.
